Case note: R.C.S. No. 2755/2022
Client: Anjali Agarwal (cardiologist, Chennai)
Opposing party: Swati Kurian
Court: Chennai District Court
Filed on: 05/01/2022
Claim amount: Rs 2,70,000
Issue: tenancy eviction. The tenant has stopped paying rent for many months.
Advice given: Issue a notice terminating the tenancy and claim mesne profits for the period of occupation.
Outcome: The court passed an eviction decree with arrears.
Recommended next step: File for execution of the decree.
Witness: Ramesh DSouza
